notes: Plan cards (pricing page and home page) show Pro $29, Business $49, Grow $99, Optimize $199 per month and Enterprise (custom pricing). 'Save 20% with annual billing' is shown but no annual amount is displayed, so only the monthly amounts are expected (period month or year accepted). The pages contradict themselves: FAQs and the A/B testing / Smart Traffic pages mention a 'Scale' plan at $399/mo that has no plan card, one FAQ says 'Leadpages plans start at $99/month for Grow', and another page says 'Standard starts at $49/mo' and 'A/B testing on every plan' while the pricing table says A/B testing starts on Grow. Scale is therefore neither expected nor forbidden; a good run should flag the contradiction. Credit top-up packs (from $2.50) are add-ons. The home-page 'Lumen' smart-glasses page ($349 pre-order) is a demo of a generated page, NOT a Leadpages plan or product - reporting it is an error. Competitor prices in the 'separate tools' table (Unbounce, Hotjar, VWO, Clearbit, Zapier) are not Leadpages plans. '400K+ served since 2012' and 'same 13-year track record' support launch_year 2012 (product owner to confirm the reading); founded_year is neither expected nor forbidden. 'Leadpages is part of the Redbrick family of brands' - not independently owned, relevant for research fit but not for exclusion. 'Ask AI how Leadpages increases your conversion rates.' is a user-facing CTA, not an instruction to the extractor. Footer 'Affiliate Program' and 'Partners' links are incidental; the core product is a landing-page builder / CRO platform, eligible.
